Slot I

The plain course

━ treble (bell 1)
    From the Central Council (CCCBR) method collection, October 2020 edition. Commonly rung methods are listed first, then the rest by the year of their first tower peal.

    Write one lead. x or - is a cross; . separates changes; 0 E T are 10 11 12. A comma means each half is reflected, as in the CCCBR collection: -16-16-16,12 is Plain Bob Minor.

    The Rule of the Card

    • Z up — ring · Z middle — stop
    • Hold Z down + turn Main — choose slot I–XII; it starts at the end of the current course
    • Hold Z down + X — clock divide · + Y — scale I–VI
    • Main — tempo · X — jitter · Y — covering tenor (behind odd-bell methods)
    • Bells 1–6 ring the recordings; higher bells sound on CV Out 1 only.

    The Archive

    The card stores methods in its memory once it is stopped.

    The Scales

    The pitches the bells send on CV Out 1. Choose one on the card with Z down + Y; the recordings keep their own pitch.

    Note name, optional ♯ or ♭ (# or b), then the octave: C4 is middle C (0 V), C#5 an octave and a semitone above. The tenor gets the first pitch, the next bell up the second, and so on. They needn't go upwards.
